frames.narration: Billing needs customer 1. It asks the layer for a Customer in its own language.
The layer asks the CRM, which answers in its own odd format.
The layer translates: a full name, a status word and a balance in cents.
Billing receives a clean Customer. It never saw a code letter or a padded number.
Record 3 has a status code the layer does not know. It refuses the record instead of guessing.
When the CRM changes or is replaced, only the layer changes. Billing stays as it is.
